 Lightning at Jets projected lineups
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 November 08, 2026 
 Link copied 
 LIGHTNING (11-3-2) at JETS (6-8-3) 
 6:00 p.m. ET; TSN3, The Spot 
 Lightning projected lineup 
 Jake Guentzel -- Brayden Point -- Nikita Kucherov
 Brandon Hagel -- Anthony Cirelli -- Gage Goncalves
 Ilya Mikheyev -- Conor Geekie -- Pontus Holmberg
 Jeffrey Viel -- Zemgus Girgensons
 J.J. Moser -- John Carlson
 Ryan McDonagh -- Erik Cernak
 Victor Hedman -- Emil Lilleberg
 Charle-Edouard D'Astous
 Andrei Vasilevskiy
 Dennis Hildeby
 Scratched: Max Crozier, Scott Sabourin 
 Injured: Yanni Gourde (hip) 
 Jets projected lineup 
 Kyle Connor -- Mark Scheifele -- Gabriel Vilardi
 Cole Perfetti -- Brayden Yager -- Dawson Mercer
 Alex Iafallo -- Adam Lowry -- Viggo Bjorck
 Cole Koepke -- Morgan Barron -- Isak Rosen
 Dylan Samberg -- Neal Pionk
 Haydn Fleury -- Dylan DeMelo
 Mario Ferraro -- Tyrel Bauer
 Stuart Skinner
 Nico Daws
 Scratched: Clay Stevenson, Nino Niederreiter, Henry Thrun, Elias Salomonsson 
 Injured: Josh Morrissey (upper body), Nick Bjugstad (undisclosed) 
 Status report 
 The Lightning did not hold a morning skate following a 4-3 overtime win at the Minnesota Wild on Saturday. … Vasilevskiy is expected to start after Hildeby made 19 saves. … The Jets held an optional skate Sunday. … Morrissey, a defenseman, skated in a regular sweater but will not play, Winnipeg coach Scott Arniel said. … Arniel said Saturday that Salomonsson, a defenseman, is away from the team dealing with a personal matter. Defenseman Henry Thrun was recalled from Manitoba of the American Hockey League on an emergency basis.
